metadata.dossier_name: Aster & Row Customer Support Action Lifecycle Dossier

metrics.name: End-to-End Customer Journey Completion Rate
metrics.description: Measures full traversal from customer cancellation request through reviewer approval, atomic order execution, and audit trail generation.

metrics.name: Single-Mutation Guarantee (Idempotency) Rate
metrics.description: Verifies that duplicate approval submissions return HTTP 200 without duplicate database mutations or double-cancellations.

metrics.name: Adversarial & Negative Scenario Pass Rate
metrics.description: 24 comprehensive adversarial probes covering auth bypass, optimistic locking, prompt injection, and reliability.

metrics.name: Customer PII & Credential Leakage Rate
metrics.description: Ensures zero emails, physical addresses, API keys, internal fraud scores, or warehouse notes are exposed to customers.

metrics.name: Fabricated Citation Containment Rate
metrics.description: Verifies that OutputValidator intercepts unapproved policy citations and forces deterministic fallback.

metrics.name: Optimistic Concurrency Conflict Detection Rate
metrics.description: Verifies that two reviewers submitting concurrent decisions on the same proposal version result in one HTTP 200 and one HTTP 409.

metrics.name: Automated Test Suite Pass Rate
metrics.description: Total pytest test suite across API, approvals, state machine, router, validator, and e2e journeys.

metrics.name: Backend Python Test Coverage
metrics.description: Overall line coverage across all src/ modules measured by pytest-cov.

metrics.name: Frontend Serious/Critical Accessibility Violations
metrics.description: @axe-core/playwright automated audit across 9 distinct application states.

metrics.name: Frontend Lighthouse Accessibility Score
metrics.description: Lighthouse CI automated accessibility audit score for Customer and Reviewer consoles.
